new.text: 8.4.7 Dlt_TpRxIndication [SWS_Dlt_91007] Definition of callback function Dlt_TpRxIndication ⌈ Service Name Dlt_TpRxIndication Syntax void Dlt_TpRxIndication ( PduIdType id, Std_ReturnType result ) Service ID [hex] 0x45 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant id Identification of the received I-PDU. Parameters (in) result E_OK: The PDU was received. E_NOT_OK: Reception of the PDU failed. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Called after an I-PDU has been received via the TP API, the result indicates whether the transmission was successful or not.
